task: Retain and select an explicitly stated fact from an older conversation turn.

creation_methodology.method: Manual synthetic fact, paraphrased follow-up query, and exact expected-answer authoring.
creation_methodology.conversation_shape: The target fact is followed by fifteen unrelated completed turns before the final query.
creation_methodology.review_status: Single-author labels; no independent adjudication or model-generated answers.

metric_contract.accuracy: Case-insensitive retention of both the case subject and exact expected answer in assembled conversation history.
metric_contract.token_reduction: One minus production assembled-history tokens divided by full raw-history tokens, averaged per case.
metric_contract.claim_boundary: This measures deterministic memory fact retention and selection, not generated-answer accuracy or semantic judge quality.
